row:
We are an ‘association of associations’, which means that our membership comprises companion animal veterinary associations from all over the world. We currently have 115 member association, representing more than 200,000 individual veterinarians. 

On our channel, you can find useful webinars on a range of topics as well as videos from members of our community. Visit our website for more information on the WSAVA and to access any of our Global Guidelines: https://wsava.org/
Make sure to stop by the WSAVA Academy to take part in our courses, from ophthalmology to gentics to animal welfare: https://academy-wsava.thinkific.com/
